title: 1.4 Major Geological Processes
description: Endogenic and exogenic forces, folding, faulting, earthquakes, tsunamis and volcanism. Medium level.

questions.question: Which fold has one limb steeper than the other?

What happens in an overthrust fold?
options: Warming is small in any year and significant only over decades
Faster decomposition releases more carbon dioxide into the air

A fracture forms and one limb is pushed forward over the other
